description: Sigiro is an observability and diagnosis layer that ingests OpenTelemetry data and returns ranked findings, suspect deploys, traces, alerts, anomalies, and runnable SQL queries. It can be used as a hosted service or self-hosted as a single binary/container.
summary: Sigiro exposes one OpenAPI-described HTTP API on `https://sigiro.com`, a self-hosted open-mode variant of the same API on `https://<your-sigiro-host>:9999`, a `sigiro` CLI, and a public streamable-HTTP MCP documentation server at `https://sigiro.com/mcp`.
